project_name: Diagrams as Code - Directed IIoT Engine

can_render_without_graphviz.details: Renders high-fidelity SVG diagrams directly using pure Python standard library string formatting without external Graphviz, Cairo, or binary dependencies.

can_position_shapes_relatively.details: Directional placement (right_of, left_of, below, above) with margin padding and alignment constraints resolved via iterative topological DAG solver.

can_position_shapes_with_unit_basis.details: Normalized coordinate placement across 0.0-1.0 unit-basis or percentage strings ('50%', '25%') mapped to canvas dimensions.

can_decouple_shape_definition_from_locat.details: Complete decoupling of shape instantiation, existence, and spatial placement. Shapes can be defined unplaced, placed late, relocated, or cloned from prototypes.

can_generate_living_bom_documentation.details: Extracts diagram inventory, group affiliations, connection topology, and technical metadata into Markdown tables and JSON catalogs.

has_auto_layout.details: A deterministic layered engine places unpinned shapes and groups from the edge structure (direction LR or TB); pinned shapes coexist via .at()/.right_of(), and a LayoutWarning flags any pin that overlaps an auto-placed sibling.

can_route_cubic_bezier_curves.details: Pure-Python analytical cubic Bezier edge routing with outward cardinal normal port tangents, distance-proportional tension scaling, native SVG M...C path rendering, and physical arc-length midpoint protocol badge placement.

can_round_orthogonal_corners.details: Quadratic Bezier corner filleting for orthogonal edges with dynamic 50% segment budget clamping, 2.0px suppression threshold, obstacle apex clearance guard, and native SVG Q commands.

capabilities.name: Core Geometry and Unit-Basis Coordinate Engine
capabilities.details: Immutable 2D geometric primitives, 9-point cardinal/intercardinal rect anchors, rect expansion/union, and normalized canvas unit-basis coordinate conversion.

capabilities.name: Decoupled Elements and Iterative DAG Constraint Solver
capabilities.details: Directed shape-to-shape relative positioning (right_of, left_of, below, above) with alignment and margin padding. Evaluates dependency DAGs with cycle detection and unconstrained element retention.

capabilities.name: Hierarchical Grouping, Auto-Bounding, and Group Flow
capabilities.details: Hierarchical container elements with bottom-up recursive auto-bounding, child coordinate delta propagation, cycle prevention, and group-to-group flow placement.

capabilities.name: Orthogonal Manhattan Routing and Port Deduction
capabilities.details: Intelligent edge connection model with automatic port deduction (North, South, East, West), orthogonal Manhattan waypoints calculation, and collinear straight-line simplification.

capabilities.name: Obstacle-Aware Orthogonal Routing and Multi-Rank Layout
capabilities.details: Segment-box collision detection with clearance corridors, shortest Manhattan detour channel routing around intermediate obstacles, and multi-rank crossing minimization via virtual dummy vertices.

capabilities.name: Cubic Bezier Edge Routing and SVG Path Generation
capabilities.details: Pure-Python analytical cubic Bezier edge routing (Routing.CURVE). Computes outward cardinal normal port tangents, distance-proportional handle heuristics, native SVG M...C path rendering with tangentially aligned destination arrowheads, and physical arc-length midpoint protocol badge positioning.
capabilities.verification: uv run pytest tests/test_geometry.py tests/test_routing.py tests/test_renderer_svg.py -k "curve or bezier"

capabilities.name: Rounded Corner Fillets for Orthogonal Routing
capabilities.details: Quadratic Bezier corner filleting for orthogonal Manhattan edges (corner_radius and arc_radius alias on Edge and Diagram). Emits native SVG Q commands with dynamic 50% segment budget clamping, straight port lead-in preservation, 2.0px threshold suppression, and obstacle clearance apex guards.
capabilities.verification: uv run pytest tests/test_geometry.py tests/test_routing.py tests/test_renderer_svg.py -k "fillet or corner_radius"

capabilities.name: Vector Theming Engine and Vector Shape Library
capabilities.details: 13 theme presets (8 dark, 4 light, 1 high-contrast), 60 built-in vector icons across 8 domains, dynamic icon loading from SVG files/directories, and standalone SVG vector primitives.

capabilities.name: Multi-Domain Reference Topologies & Automated Test Suite
capabilities.details: 88 executable domain reference diagrams across cloud, ai, computer, datacenter, business_process, cybersecurity, network_engineering, and iiot demonstrating multi-theme styling, BOM generation, and automated test verification.

capabilities.name: Auto-Layout Engine and Editable Layout File
capabilities.details: Deterministic Sugiyama-style ranked placement (layout="auto", direction LR or TB) for unpinned shapes and groups scope by scope; an editable JSON layout file keyed by explicit id= or label path (diagrams-as-code layout export); pinned shapes and relative placement coexist with auto-placed siblings, with a LayoutWarning raised on overlap.
capabilities.verification: uv run pytest tests/test_layout_layered.py tests/test_layout_graph.py tests/test_layout_pipeline.py tests/test_layout_sidecar.py

capabilities.name: The diagrams-as-code Command
capabilities.details: Entrypoint diagrams-as-code (also python -m diagrams_as_code) with subcommands render, layout export, themes, and icons; batch-renders scripts or directories to SVG/PNG/BOM, exports layout files, and lists built-in themes and icons. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 a script failed, 2 usage error.

capabilities.name: Pure-Python Zero-Binary SVG Vector Renderer
capabilities.details: Produces valid, standalone W3C SVG XML documents featuring responsive viewBox scaling, arrowhead markers, drop shadow filters, ordered group rendering, and automated luminance contrast text coloring.

capabilities.name: Fluent Diagram Context Manager and Operator Syntax
capabilities.details: Pythonic context manager with bitshift connection operator overloading (s1 >> s2, s1 >> diag.edge(...) >> s2, fan-in/fan-out lists), automatic group scoping, decoupled shape lifecycles, and prototype cloning.

capabilities.name: Living Documentation & Bill of Materials (BOM) Engine
capabilities.details: Extracts diagram inventory, parent groups, connection routes, and technical metadata into Markdown tables and JSON catalogs, with automated README.md synchronization.

capabilities.name: Interactive SVG Pan-Zoom and Collapsible Groups
capabilities.details: Pure-Python client-side interactive SVG generation with zero external runtime dependencies. Features responsive click-drag viewport panning, cursor-anchored mouse wheel zoom, viewport reset HUD controls, and interactive collapsible groups with header toggles and recursive visibility propagation.

capabilities.name: CLI Interactive Export Option
capabilities.details: Command-line flags (--interactive, --no-interactive) for diagrams-as-code render and batch directory exports to emit responsive, pan/zoom-enabled SVG assets directly.

capabilities.name: Client-Side Search and Node Highlighting
capabilities.details: Client-side search input field integrated directly into the HUD controls. Dynamically matches node labels and IDs, dimming non-matching elements and highlighting matches in real-time.

capabilities.name: Viewport Minimap Overview and Drag Navigation
capabilities.details: Pinned overview minimap thumbnail widget rendered in the bottom-right corner of interactive SVG canvases, featuring responsive visible bounds rectangle and smooth drag navigation.

capabilities.name: Obstacle Detection and Deflection for Curved Edges
capabilities.details: Two-tier collision detection combining bounding box broadphase filtering with recursive De Casteljau subdivision, automatic reverse-flow lateral port resolution and escape routing, and adaptive C1-continuous spline deflection waypoints around intervening obstacles.
